digest.component_or_area: rebar-gerrit host infrastructure; CloudWatch alarms; disk space management
propositions: rebar-gerrit root volume filled to 100% (29 GiB of 30 GiB) and took Gerrit offline for ~5 hours; root disk reaches 100% despite four prior mitigation rounds that accelerated reclaim without bounding the ceiling
host-published disk alarms treat missing data as notBreaching, causing the alarm to self-clear to OK when the metrics publisher dies rather than remaining in alarm state

root disk consumed by three unbounded accumulators: Docker orphaned overlay2 layers (~6.5 GiB invisible to prune), /var/tmp (~3.6 GiB), and journald (~1.7 GiB), plus 4.8 GiB of container writable layers with zero reclaimable
alarm fired 11 times in 24 hours with every SNS notification delivered, maintaining continuous alarm state for 3h33m before outage; alert fatigue prevented action despite proper notification delivery

data volume /var/gerrit lacks enforcement that rebar code writes only to site/ subdirectory; unbounded off-box evidence staging can accumulate on the volume without detection until 85% capacity alarm fires
